Parent builds byte-identical pinned SDK under installed app vendor/supertonic; sdk_root must end at supertonic package, whose parent worker prepends to sys.path. The path must resolve to cloned SDK, not site-packages.

Existing stage manifest does NOT hash worker.py, speech.py or admission.py. It hashes source_pins.py, controls.py, __init__.py plus SDK and unchanged native guard helpers. Keep both environments aligned for relocated worker paths.

Host contention rejects with LocalAudioBusy; zero additional global queued waiters and zero fallback.

Evaluation retains its read-only production priority checks and cancels/reaps its own work on detected production. A currently held evaluation flock makes new production TTS fail fast; no new preemption/intent signalling was introduced.

Bridge shields the child-owning bounded-process task and sends cancellation once, draining repeated caller cancellations before releasing host lock/ASR/local slot. Existing disabled process path untouched.
